Card Q&A.a: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.
Card Q&A.q: Multiple effects trigger when this card digivolves. In what order can they be activated?

If my opponent doesn't delete one of their Digimon or Tamers, I can't trash their top security card, and this Digimon can't unsuspend for this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect, does that mean it doesn't count toward the [Once Per Turn] limit?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] By playing 1 [Lucemon: Larva] from your trash to your empty breeding area without paying the cost, delete all of your opponent's Digimon with the highest level.
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Your opponent may delete 1 of their Digimon or Tamers. If this effect didn't delete, trash their top security card and this Digimon unsuspends.
